title: TeamCity Server Process Spawning OS Command Shell (CVE-2026-63077)
id: 6f2a1c7e-4b90-4d55-8a3e-9c1f0b2e77aa
status: experimental
description: Detects the JetBrains TeamCity On-Premises server JVM (java/javaw from a TeamCity path) spawning a command interpreter or recon binary, the post-exploitation footprint of the CVE-2026-63077 unauthenticated agent-polling-protocol RCE.
references:
  - https://blog.jetbrains.com/teamcity/2026/07/cve-2026-63077/
  - https://www.ionix.io/threat-center/cve-2026-63077/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/28
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|contains: 'teamcity'
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\java.exe'

      - '\cmd.exe'

id: 6f2b1a94-2d17-4c8a-9c1e-0a7d3e4f9b21
description: Detects Mirage Kitten (UNC1549) NightLedger backdoor loaded as a co-located malicious SspiCli.dll by a legitimate AppVShNotify.exe from a non-system directory.
references:
  - https://securelist.com/mirage-kitten-new-tools/120811/
  - https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/suspected-iranian-unc1549-targets-israel-middle-east
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/28
tags:
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1574.001
  - attack.defense_evasion
logsource:
  category: image_load
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\AppVShNotify.exe'
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\SspiCli.dll'
  filter_system:
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
      - 'C:\Windows\System32'
      - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64'
      - 'C:\Windows\WinSxS'
  condition: selection and not filter_system
level: high
2564.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="AppVShNotify.exe" AND NOT (Processes.process_path IN ("*\\Program Files\\Microsoft Office\\*","*\\Program Files (x86)\\Microsoft Office\\*","*\\Microsoft Application Virtualization\\*","*\\WindowsApps\\*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2564.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:7 @Image:(*\\AppVShNotify.exe OR *\\appvshnotify.exe OR *\\APPVSHNOTIFY.EXE) (SspiCli OR sspicli) -@ImageLoaded:(C\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*)
2564.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\AppVShNotify\.exe$/i
| NOT ImageFileName=/\\(Microsoft Office|Microsoft Application Virtualization|WindowsApps)\\/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, MD5HashData], function=count())

id: a9f3d21c-4e08-4b7a-9c65-1d2f6b8e0347
description: Detects a shell/curl process posting to the Telegram bot API sendDocument/sendMessage endpoints, matching the BlueNoroff macOS stealer hard-coded exfil to the Aurora channel
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/bluenoroff-zoom-phishing-kit-profiles.html
  - https://crypto.news/north-korea-hackers-scan-crypto-wallets-through-fake-zoom-calls/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/27
tags:
  - attack.t1567
  - attack.t1555.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: macos
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/curl'
      - '/bash'
      - '/sh'
      - '/zsh'
    CommandLine|contains: 'api.telegram.org/bot'
  selection_api:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'sendDocument'
      - 'sendMessage'
  condition: selection and selection_api
level: high
2694.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("curl","bash","sh","zsh","osascript") AND Processes.process="*api.telegram.org/bot*" AND (Processes.process="*sendDocument*" OR Processes.process="*sendMessage*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2694.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\/(curl|bash|sh|zsh|osascript)$/i
| CommandLine=/api\.telegram\.org\/bot/i
| CommandLine=/(sendDocument|sendMessage)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, CommandLine], function=count())

2695.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Certighost Exploit Lets Low-Privileged Active Directory Users Impersonate a Doma
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("certpdef.dll"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("certpdef.dll"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2695.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Certighost Exploit Lets Low-Privileged Active Directory Users Impersonate a Doma ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("certpdef.dll"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")

| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

2697.def:
let lookback = 1d;
let KnownLdapServers = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp between (ago(30d) .. ago(1d))
    | where RemotePort == 389
    | summarize by RemoteIP;   // established LDAP servers approximate real DCs
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
| where RemotePort in (389, 445)
| where RemoteIPType == "Private"
| summarize Ports = make_set(RemotePort), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), ConnCount = count(),
            InitProc = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName)
        by DeviceName, RemoteIP
| where set_has_element(Ports, 389) and set_has_element(Ports, 445)   // CA reached rogue host on LDAP + SMB
| join kind=leftanti KnownLdapServers on RemoteIP                     // drop established DCs
| order by FirstSeen desc
2697.sent:
let KnownLdapServers = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(1d))
    | where DstPortNumber == 389
    | summarize by DstIpAddr;
ImNetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where DstPortNumber in (389, 445)
| summarize Ports = make_set(DstPortNumber), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), ConnCount = count()
        by SrcHostname, DstIpAddr
| where set_has_element(Ports, 389) and set_has_element(Ports, 445)
| join kind=leftanti KnownLdapServers on DstIpAddr
| order by FirstSeen desc
2697.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as dest_ports from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_port IN (389,445) AND All_Traffic.dest_category!="domain_controller" by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)`
| where mvcount(mvfilter(match(dest_ports,"^389$")))>0 AND mvcount(mvfilter(match(dest_ports,"^445$")))>0
2697.falcon:
#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4
| in(field=RemotePort, values=["389","445"])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, RemoteAddressIP4], function=[count(as=conns), count(field=RemotePort, distinct=true, as=distinctPorts)])
| distinctPorts>=2
